# E0504: a value in the data is outside what the schema allows

A value in the data is of the right kind but outside what the schema allows:
out of a bound the schema sets, failing a validator it applies, or not the
constant it fixes. Here the schema bounds `count` and fixes `kind`.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				kind:  "ship"
				count: int & >=0 & <10
			}
		}
	}
}
```

`data.json`:

```json
{
	"kind":  "boat",
	"count": 12
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0504]: kind in the data is "boat", but schema 0.0 requires "ship"
 --> data.json:2:11
  |
2 |     "kind":  "boat",
  |              ^^^^^^
  |
 ::: lineage.cue:6:5
  |
6 |                 kind:  "ship"
  |                 ---- required here
  |
  = detail: kind: conflicting values "ship" and "boat"

error[E0504]: count in the data is 12, outside the bound <10 that schema 0.0 sets
 --> data.json:3:11
  |
3 |     "count": 12
  |              ^^
  |
 ::: lineage.cue:7:12
  |
7 |                 count: int & >=0 & <10
  |                        --- the bound is set here
  |
  = detail: count: invalid value 12 (out of bound <10)
```
